snippet.title: Toada Brava - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Free yourself from a brutal labor camp and lead a motley crew of outlaws to freedom in *Toada Brava* , a hand-drawn 2D JRPG inspired by classics like *Chrono Trigger* , *Super Mario RPG* , and *Vagrant Story* . Every battle, animation, and cutscene moves like a cartoon, bringing the magic of your favorite childhood cartoons straight into a game you can play.

Engage in ATB turn-based combat with timing mechanics, where every attack and defence matters. Use your weapons to interact with the world, cast area-of-effect magic, and take down enemies strategically. Battles happen right on the spot, with no random encounters or tedious transitions.

### Key Features

- Battles happen right where you are, no random encounters or long transitions.
- ATB turn-based combat with timing mechanics, where every attack and defence matters.
- Interact with the world using your weapons, strike objects to find items or gain an advantage over enemies.
- Cast area-of-effect magic, hitting multiple enemies at once for strategic impact.
- Expressive characters and rich animation bring every party member to life with charm and personality.
- Form a party of outlaws and misfits, each with unique abilities and stories.
- Streamlined gameplay and story, giving you a satisfying JRPG experience without unnecessary padding.

Meet expressive, charismatic characters, form a party of rebels, and uncover the secrets of a corrupt aristocracy. With rich animation, tight gameplay, and a story that respects players’ time, Toada Brava delivers a vibrant JRPG experience you won’t forget.
